title: Writing Back in the Old Days of New Orleans for an English visitor
summary: Punch explains and sings his song Back in the Old Days of New Orleans, conceived after an English visitor asked about the city; he says he made it up.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Oh, it's a beautiful song. It seems to me like a fella came up to me. And he said, I'm from England, the old country. I read about New Orleans so much. Night clubs, they open all night. Day and music going all the time. And people don't sleep. See, I want to know something about it. And it just seemed to me I'd sit down and give him the idea of it. Years ago we'll talk about a city that stood open every night and day. The music would be playing. The people would be swaying. Then they might come up a fight. Everyone was always gay and mellow. Singing, dancing. I forgot my tune. Day and night or something. Night, yeah. Well, you got to let me get it. I got, I got it. I forgot all about it. I'll get it. It's so hard, then. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. About a little plant

That stood open every day and night While the music would be playing People would be swaying Then they might come up a fight Everyone was always gay and mellow Laughing, talking as the dance goes on Then everyone would stop still And someone would yell blow bill They're fighting over there, two fellas Then it would be over very soon And the dance would go right on Why it would just lie if nothing had happened For no one would ever leave the dance for home No, no, anything else you would like to know about Something that you've really never seen Why it's been a long time ago But someone will tell you more Of back in the old days of New Orleans That's the best song I wrote for myself That's a good number I wrote that for myself
Are you dedicating it to anyone or anything?

Well, no, I'm scared to steal it I'm on a copywriter first I ain't a copywriter But who did you write that for? An English boy? Yeah, he asked me the question about New Orleans And I explained to him the best I could
Was that a real fella? Or was that
Yeah I must have been asleep Dreaming or something
